# clean_game_hash_files

[← Command index](README.md)

Rewrite every game hash file with its entries in sorted order.

## Synopsis

```
clean_game_hash_files [options]
```

## Description

Reads each per-subcategory hash file under `Hashes/` in the game metadata repository
and writes it back with entries sorted by path and keys sorted within each entry, so
the files stay stable under version control.

Reading a file also adds any missing encrypted-field keys (`filename_enc`, `hash_enc`,
`size_enc`), and entries with the same directory and file name collapse into one.

## Options

### Common options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-v, --verbose` | Enable verbose mode. |
| `-p, --pretend_run` | Do a pretend run with no permanent changes. |
| `-x, --exit_on_failure` | Enable exit on failure mode. |
| `--no-preview` | Skip the preview confirmation prompt. |

## Examples

### Sort every hash file

```bash
clean_game_hash_files
```

### Sort without the confirmation prompt

```bash
clean_game_hash_files --no-preview
```

### Show which files would be sorted

```bash
clean_game_hash_files -p -v
```

## Notes

- There are no selection options; every hash file for every supercategory is processed.
